0.text:
Dearest Cowherd, I pray that the heavens shall permit us to meet this year. Your absence always causes me great pain] and my loom grows slow once again. The night approaches as I weave this last brocade] and I can hear the magpies calling by the river.
Wait for me] my love, I shall be with you soon.

1.text: O' Weaver Maid, I pray for the blessing of a husband and sons. Grant me a harmonious marriage such as your own.

2.text: Man] I wish my girlfriend would come back to me. I know I treated her wrong] but she can't treat me like this. No communication whatsoever] I swear. Only told me that she's breaking it off and to get out of her house] but I know I can treat her better if she just gives me another chance. Whoever's listening up there, make it happen.

3.text: I wish I had a bajillion gazillion dollars so I can make my family and my teachers and my friends really really happy. I would make so many new friends because if someone doesn't like me, then I'll just buy them some cake.

4.text:
I pray that my family lives long, happy, and blessed lives.
I pray that my wife survives her surgery in good health and good mind] and I pray that when the time comes, we will exit this world together] hand-in-hand.

5.text:
I wish I could hold hands with him in public] but we can't] and it's killing me. One day. One day is all I ask for.
When will I get my own magpie bridge?

6.text: O' Weaver Maid, I pray that you will bless my hands with your divine weaving talent. Bestow upon me the skill to allow my needle to fly across the cloth.

7.text:
Why are all the people I meet on the apps so UGHHHHHHHHHHHH?
Wish I could find a normal person on there] but apparently] they're an extinct species or something] I guess.

8.text:
I wish my friend would talk to me again. I don't get why they're so angry] but I feel terrible] and I just want to apologize. I'm sorry.
That's all I want to say, but my chance is gone] and it might be gone forever.

9.text: I hope we're friends forever. Although I'm super dudebro with him on the outside] I can't believe I managed to snag the greatest friend ever. Hope that we'll still be in-touch after we graduate.

10.text: The government might say our marriage is fake and a sin, but what sin is it even? Is it the crime of loving someone too similar to you? Is that considered vain? Whatever it is, the only thing I could ever wish for if I were in front of Them is to see you again.

11.text:
I'm begging for a stroke of good luck or protection or anything remotely helpful.
Give me the strength to escape him and leave safely. I need it soon, or I think I won't be here for much longer.

12.text: Thirteen long years have passed, yet I think of him still. Arrogant. Frivolous. Kind. If I am not to see him again in this lifetime, I only ask that I am by his side again in the next.

13.text: AAAH! I hope we get married someday! Maybe it's too early to be saying that] but he's the most perfect boyfriend ever! I really want to tell my kids that their parents were high school sweethearts like in those old timey movies.

14.text:
I feel sick to my stomach. She's getting married off] and there's nothing I can do about it. I wish I could stop this] but I'm not a man] so I can't be the one to marry her.
She texted me again last night saying that she'll always love me. I can't do this; I'm going to throw up.

15.text:
There must be something more to life than wasting away in this palace, waiting to serve an Emperor who cares naught for me. I wish I was one of the dragonflies that grace the pond near my chambers.
I would fly away, never to be caged again, but that is just my wishful thinking for what am I now if not already a songbird trapped in a gilded prison?

16.text: Give me a wife already who isn't a useless] disgusting piece of meat. We've had nothing but daughters] yet she still refuses my advances, acting like she even has the right to do so.

17.text:
Please make my brother get better. I don't know why he's sick] but the doctor said it was because of something called “cancer”. I hate hospitals. I hate cancer. My family is sad] and my mommy and daddy won't stop crying.
I'm always sad now too.

18.text:
Curse it all, why won't she just see reason?
Sometimes I wish I could just grab her by the shoulders, shake her really hard, and scream at her that she'll be nothing more than a wife and mother to him. She makes the excuse that she really loves him] but I know better.
She never called him “baby”] and she never will.

19.text:
Dearest Weaver Maiden, the magpies are here now. It has been many seasons since I last saw you] and I can hardly still my racing heart.
Looking up, heaven's skies are clear tonight] so I shall step onto the bridge with confidence] and soon, I will have you in my arms, if only until the sun exits from its chambers.
